comment: No source is published; the maker's page is at kilpatrickaudio.com/?p=virtue-vcv. An incoming controller value of 0 to 127 is divided by 127 and then scaled by the range switch. The three range settings are scale 10 with offset -5, scale 5 with offset 0, and scale 10 with offset 0, and the switch frames are loaded bottom, middle, top, so they line up with the -5-5, 0-5 and 0-10 markings printed beside it.
